objective: 在现有 Agent public snapshot 与 DriverHost RunSnapshot projection 内显式投影 Runtime V2 current node/slice/path-relative entry/latest occurrence/evidence revision及assessment availability，不增加mutable owner、Driver authority或wire变化

semantic_brief.summary: Buyer：R8 Runtime owner flip已由Sol验证。DriverHost当前仍只通过derived Belief和legacy transition读取，缺少显式V2 current/entry/occurrence。复用immutable ContainerRuntimeV2State作为只读源，扩展现有snapshot/projector；无latest Fast slot时诚实Unavailable。
core_points: FAST_TRUSTED != PUBLISHED_MEMORY；latest assessment未保留时标记Unavailable

change_principles: 先搜索Agent/DriverHost现有V2/current/transition snapshot职责；裁决固定为复用ContainerRuntimeV2State并扩展AgentStateSnapshot/RunSnapshotProjector，不创建第二read service、interface、registry、cache或mutable owner
AgentStateSnapshot只复制Agent.ContainerContext的既有immutable public projection；不得读取private V2 field或携带ActiveContainerContext、Container、Traversal、Environment、progress mutable handle或provider

RunSnapshot增加最小classified字段：CurrentContainer NodeRef、CurrentSliceRef、Entry SourceNodeRef、Entry TransitionOccurrenceRef、可选Entry RelationRef、latest V2 TransitionOccurrence、EvidenceRevision、Fast assessment availability
V2 current/entry/occurrence/revision字段来自Agent.ContainerContext并分类DirectPublicProjection；legacy typed transition继续DerivedReadModel compatibility/audit且不得覆盖V2 occurrence
没有V2 state的older/manual snapshot所有V2字段均NotCurrentlyAvailable；root EntryContext缺失是known-null direct value，不得误报整个V2 current unavailable
Fast assessment因production不保存latest assessment必须NotCurrentlyAvailable并解释no mutable latest slot by design；不得从Graph/Belief/legacy transition推断Fast结果
r5必须同时显示V2 physical SettingsRoot与ActiveExecution Display；multi-entry snapshot必须保留path-relative EntryContext refs；读取确定性、零mutation
保持CurrentSemanticPage/CurrentObservedLocation/legacy transition/evidence catalog/asset/Goal/Action/Recovery字段兼容；不得解析Reason推断V2字段
若RunSnapshot source hash受既有Harness frozen-source guard约束，只允许机械更新RunSnapshot.cs对应hash；不得修改guard语义、白名单或其他hash
所有新公开字段/property必须XML doc和NEW_SYMBOL_JUSTIFICATION；你不是仓库唯一执行者，不得回退用户/他人dirty-tree修改
acceptance: 真实Agent snapshot证明AgentStateSnapshot/RunSnapshot只复制ContainerContext且读取不改变V2 state、Belief、ActiveContext、progress、trace或Container evidence
r5 live Agent projection同时显示V2 current semantic/node/slice/revision=SettingsRoot evidence与ActiveExecution=Display，Observed!=Execution不被合并
multi-entry/return projection显示同Settings node的当前path-relative EntryContext source/occurrence refs，root entry为known-null direct值而older snapshot为Unavailable
latest V2 occurrence与legacy latest transition分别投影；exact refs/revision匹配但classification明确不同，legacy不能成为current occurrence authority
Fast assessment availability显式NotCurrentlyAvailable，source说明production不保存latest assessment；无Graph/Belief/reason推断
结构检查证明DriverHost无V2 mutable field/cache、无ActiveContainerContext/Container handle、无Action/Goal/Recovery/provider authority
现有DriverHost/RunSnapshot/wire tests保持兼容且wire DTO/operation源码零修改；若frozen hash变化仅RunSnapshot hash机械更新
DriverHost focused、R8 live、Architecture、solution build、full relevant suite、consistency、strict OpenSpec及git diff --check通过；AuthorityDelta=NONE、BehaviorDelta=NONE、NET_NEW_MUTABLE_TRUTH=0
forbidden: 禁止新增V2/current/Graph mutable state、latest Fast/Slow/trust/correction/checkpoint、DriverHost cache/store/registry或Runtime coordinator
禁止修改Agent reconciliation、GoalEvidence、Action authorization/dispatch、Recovery、_branchProgress、Container local evidence或transition classification
禁止修改wire/transport DTO、operation、CLI/TUI、control protocol、capture schema或external behavior
禁止向DriverHost暴露ActiveContainerContext、live Container/Traversal/Environment、mutable collections、provider或action/recovery handle
禁止从Reason/diagnostic/ContainerId/action顺序/缺失字段推断V2 current、entry、occurrence、Fast assessment或world truth
禁止修改OpenSpec、docs、tasks/evidence/WorkItem；禁止放宽Harness guard或旧测试断言取得GREEN
escalation: 若显式V2 read projection必须新增Runtime mutable owner或latest assessment slot，返回AUTHORITY_GATE_REQUIRED
若RunSnapshot字段必然改变wire DTO/operation或外部协议，返回HUMAN_GATE_REQUIRED
若immutable V2 state无法安全公开且需要新长期read subsystem/interface，先返回REUSE/EXTEND/REFACTOR/CREATE比较与NEW_SYMBOL_JUSTIFICATION，不自行创建
若scope文件有不明并发冲突或失败指向scope外，保留现场并返回Expected/Observed/Gap/FirstDivergence/Owner
